name: acme/quality-checks
description: e2e fixture module -- single-module quality checks with no cross-module interaction (hardcoded secrets, deprecated code, license risk, PHP static-analysis findings, Magento upgrade readiness). Deliberately under an Acme_* namespace, not Vendor_* like its siblings in this fixture -- php-analyzer's phpmd/phpcs --exclude/--ignore flags (vendor/*, */vendor/*) match case-insensitively against a path segment literally named "Vendor", so a module living under app/code/Vendor/* silently gets its whole directory excluded from both tools. phpunit_failure lives in the separate Vendor_PhpunitSample module (unaffected -- it doesn't go through phpmd/phpcs at all) -- see its own composer.json too.
